meta.title: T. rex lived closer to YOU than to Stegosaurus?
meta.source: User script (verbatim). Stegosaurus ~155–145 Mya (Late Jurassic); T. rex ~68–66 Mya; gap ≥ ~77 My vs 66 My to today. Sources: Smithsonian, Gizmodo, Discovery, AMNH.

scenes.name: Hook

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: What if I told you T. rex lived closer to YOU than to Stegosaurus?

spoken: What if I told you, Tee rex lived closer to you, than to Stegosaurus?

scenes.name: Stegosaurus

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Stegosaurus roamed Earth about 150 million years ago.

scenes.note: Stegosaurus: Late Jurassic, ~155–145 million years ago

scenes.name: T. rex appears

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But T. rex didn’t appear until around 68 million years ago!

scenes.note: T. rex: Late Cretaceous, ~68–66 million years ago
spoken: But Tee rex didn't appear until around sixty-eight million years ago!

scenes.name: The gap

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That’s roughly 77 million years separating these two dinosaurs.

scenes.note: ~145 → ~68 million years ago = about 77 million years
spoken: That's roughly seventy-seven million years separating these two dinosaurs.

scenes.name: Extinction

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: T. rex went extinct just 66 million years ago.

spoken: Tee rex went extinct just sixty-six million years ago.

scenes.name: Closer to you

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That means you’re closer in time to T. rex than T. rex ever was to Stegosaurus!

scenes.note: 66 million years (T. rex → you) < 77+ million (Stegosaurus → T. rex)
spoken: That means you're closer in time to Tee rex, than Tee rex ever was to Stegosaurus!
